title: Modern Football Tactics: High Pressing Structures, Counter-Pressing & Rest Defense
description: Specialized sports English module analyzing high-pressing triggers, aggressive counter-pressing traps, rest defense structures, and transitional play.
learning_objectives: Master advanced football coaching and tactical terminology (pressing triggers, compact block, half-spaces, rest defense, transition)
Apply conditional structures and modal verbs to real match-play decisions and tactical instructions
Eliminate Czech interference errors when discussing game phases, match statistics, and tactical adjustments

questions.prompt: When the opposing goalkeeper plays a short pass to the centre-back, our front line _____ the ball carrier immediately.

explanations.correct: Modal verb 'must' is followed directly by the bare infinitive 'press' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal verbs never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'is must' is completely invalid English syntax.
explanations.wrong_D: 'must' cannot take a present participle with '-ing'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsoboém slovesu 'must' následuje vždy holý infinitiv bez 'to': 'must press' (nikoli *must to press*).

questions.prompt: If the opposing full-back _____ backwards towards his goalkeeper, our wingers will step up and initiate the pressing trap.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause requires Present Simple ('passes') to describe a realistic tactical trigger.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside an if-clause in standard English.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would pass' forms an unreal conditional, which does not match future 'will step up'.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'passed' requires 'would' in the main clause (Second Conditional).
explanations.wrong_C: Option C is incorrect in this technical context.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkové větě po 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If the full-back will pass*). Správně je přítomný čas: 'If the full-back passes'.

questions.prompt: If our defenders _____ deeper into a compact low block, the opponent would find it much harder to exploit spaces behind.

explanations.correct: Second conditional requires Past Simple ('sat') to match hypothetical 'would find' in the main clause.
explanations.wrong_B: 'sit' is Present Simple and would require 'will find' in the result clause.
explanations.wrong_C: Cannot use 'will sit' inside an if-clause.
explanations.wrong_D: 'have sat' creates a mismatched tense with conditional 'would find'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Druhý kondicionál (hypotéza v přítomnosti) vyžaduje v 'if' větě minulý čas prostý: 'If our defenders sat... they would find...'.

questions.prompt: During the second half, the central midfield pairing _____ laterally across the pitch to close down passing lanes.

explanations.correct: Present Continuous 'is shifting' correctly describes an active, ongoing tactical movement during the match.
explanations.wrong_B: 'are shift' is ungrammatical; continuous tense requires '-ing'.
explanations.wrong_D: Participle 'shifting' alone cannot act as a complete predicate without auxiliary 'is'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Průběhový přítomný čas vyžaduje pomocné sloveso 'is/are' + tvar na -ing: 'is shifting laterally'.

questions.prompt: The attacking playmaker made a sharp diagonal run _____ the half-space to receive the through ball.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'into' denotes movement from outside into a specific tactical zone (the half-space).
explanations.wrong_B: 'in to' as two words is incorrect for directional movement into a spatial area.
explanations.wrong_C: 'onto of' is an invalid double preposition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'between of' is ungrammatical; 'between' does not take 'of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Pohyb dovnitř prostoru vyjadřuje předložka 'into': 'run into the half-space'.

questions.prompt: The visiting team's midfield _____ by a coordinated counter-pressing wave within three seconds of losing the ball.

explanations.correct: Passive Voice 'was dispossessed' correctly conveys that the midfield suffered the turnover from the pressing wave.
explanations.wrong_C: Active voice 'dispossessed' incorrectly implies the midfield won the ball themselves.
explanations.wrong_D: 'has dispossessed' is active and present, failing to match passive past context.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod v minulém čase vyžaduje 'was/were' + minulé příčestí: 'was dispossessed' (byl obrán o míč).

questions.prompt: The defensive midfielder looks completely exhausted; he _____ over 12 kilometres during the 90 minutes.

explanations.correct: Past modal of deduction 'must have run' expresses logical certainty based on present visible evidence.
explanations.wrong_C: 'should have run' implies criticism or unfulfilled obligation rather than logical deduction.
explanations.wrong_D: 'could run' refers to general ability or hypothetical possibility, not deduction about past effort.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logický úsudek o minulosti na základě důkazů vyjadřuje 'must have + příčestí': 'must have run' (určitě naběhal).

questions.prompt: The home team recorded significantly _____ ball possession than the away side in the first half.

explanations.wrong_B: 'more high' is ungrammatical for single-syllable adjectives.

questions.cz_learning_point: Jednoslabičná přídavná jména tvoří 2. stupeň koncovkou -er: 'higher possession than', nikoli *more high*.

questions.prompt: When executing a rapid counter-attack: _____, win the second ball; next, play forward; finally, attack the penalty box.

explanations.correct: Sequence marker 'First' introduces the primary step in a sequential tactical drill.
explanations.wrong_B: 'At first' means 'initially' (contrasting with later change of mind), not chronological step one.
explanations.wrong_D: 'At the first' is incorrect in sequence enumeration.

questions.cz_learning_point: Pro první krok v posloupnosti použijte 'First' nebo 'Firstly', nikoli *At first* (které znamená 'zpočátku, nejprve ale pak jinak').

questions.prompt: Coach to winger: 'Could you please _____ back and double up against their overlapping full-back?'

explanations.correct: Polite request with modal 'Could you please' requires the bare infinitive 'track'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'to track' is incorrect because modal auxiliaries do not take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'tracked' is ungrammatical after modal 'could'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po zdvořilé žádosti 'Could you please' následuje vždy základní tvar slovesa (bare infinitive): 'Could you please track back?'.
